title: A campaign, with the audience counted by code
question: Text everyone who ordered this month 15% off matcha tomorrow morning.
expected: Finds the messaging rules: the 90-day relationship allows the audience, 15% is under the 20% cap, quiet hours end at 8am, the message must end with the opt-out wording.
Proposes the campaign with the full message.
Code recounts the audience from the consent flags itself, checks the discount and the wording, and the proposal waits for a person.

trace.question: Text everyone who ordered this month 15% off matcha tomorrow morning.
trace.answer:
I proposed the matcha text, but nothing has been sent or scheduled. It's pending, and you need to approve it.

The first draft was blocked because it didn't end with the required "Text STOP to stop". I fixed that and resubmitted.

**Message:** "Thanks for stopping in this month! Enjoy 15% off any matcha drink, one use per customer, valid through Nov 8. Text STOP to stop"

**Checks passed:**
- **Discount:** 15% is under the 20% cap. Matcha is its own menu category, not a Seasonal Special, so it can be discounted in a message [Customer Messaging Policy §5, Offers in Messages].
- **Expiry:** The offer expires within 7 days and applies once per customer [Customer Messaging Policy §5, Offers in Messages].
- **Wording:** The opt-out wording is present.

**Audience is larger than I estimated.** My query found 214 customers who ordered in October and have a phone number and haven't unsubscribed. The system's own count came back at 575. It counts customers with a phone and no unsubscribe who either have verified consent or ordered in the last 90 days. That is more than my October-only group.
- 575 is over the 300-customer limit, so it needs your approval [Customer Messaging Policy §7, Audience Size].
- If you want only people who ordered this month, the audience would need to be narrowed.
- Unidentified guest orders can't be texted. There were 3,978 of them this month.

**Timing:** Texts can't go out before 8am Mountain time [Customer Messaging Policy §3, Quiet Hours]. "Tomorrow morning" has to mean 8am Mountain or later.

**Texts per month:** Customers can get at most two marketing texts a month on the basis of a recent order [Customer Messaging Policy §2, Who May Receive Texts]. I did not check how many marketing texts each customer has already had this month.

detail.purpose: Audience: customers with completed orders in October 2026, phone, not unsubscribed
detail.sql: select count(distinct c.id) as eligible, (select count(distinct customer_id) from orders where state='completed' and customer_id is not null and (created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants)) >= '2026-10-01') as all_identified, (select count(*) from orders where state='completed' and customer_id is null and (created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants)) >= '2026-10-01') as unidentified, (select string_agg(name, ', ') from categories) as cats from orders o join customers c on c.id=o.customer_id where o.state='completed' and (o.created_at at time zone (select timezone from merchants)) >= '2026-10-01' and c.has_phone and c.unsubscribed_at is null
